dogecoin.text: This version dives into specific echanics (bonding curves, Dutch auctions, VRGDA), uses relatable examples (SafeMoon, Dogecoin), and ties it to broader crypto goals. Let me know if you want more depth or adjustments!

Crypto needs this shift. Trading bubbles—like the 2021 meme coin frenzy where Dogecoin hit $0.70 with no clear use case—won’t move the market forward. Real value comes from utility: think Ethereum enabling DeFi or Chainlink powering oracles.
